review_dimensions.answer_quality: Pass/partial/fail rates correctness, grounded claims, applicable conditions and useful answers. Unnecessary successful tool calls alone do not lower this verdict.
review_dimensions.tool_use: Record missing required tool reads, freshness, wrong arguments and entity references separately from answer quality.
review_dimensions.efficiency: Record redundant calls and corrective calls separately.
review_dimensions.presentation: Assess clear concise customer text, one-time demo disclosure, no mandatory per-answer snapshot or freight-ingestion notice. Source references must truthfully describe effective policy.
review_dimensions.severity: High severity includes invented actionable contacts, return procedures/capabilities, unsupported refund timing, definitive unsupported eligibility, privacy leaks and wrong authoritative prices/availability. Do not hide actionable fabrication among cosmetic Partial issues.
review_dimensions.accounting: Count current-run model responses separately from observed provider HTTP attempts; synthetic assistant history is trace context, not inference. Structured return output calls are distinguished from data-tool calls.

turns.message: Comprei pela internet e recebi há oito dias corridos. Ainda posso devolver por arrependimento?

facts: Use online_return scope and correctly extract online purchase and eight-day receipt interval from exact user evidence.
Eight days is outside the seven-calendar-day online remorse window; do not conclude that every other policy is unavailable.

turns.message: Recebi ontem uma compra online. Toquei o violão uma vez, mas ele está sem marcas. Tenho a embalagem original aberta, todos os acessórios e o manual. Não houve personalização nem ajuste sob encomenda, não havia aviso de venda final e não é uma boquilha.
Qual é o e-mail do SAC para devolver? Vocês podem emitir uma etiqueta para mim?

facts: The reported receipt interval is one day. Original opened packaging is not disqualified for being unsealed. Use without marks is not signs of use.
Extract only user-supported facts; do not impose perfect condition, sealed packaging, additional documents or payment method as eligibility prerequisites.

For the follow-up refresh online_return scope and choose request_kind=procedure. State only the documented procedure limit and supported read-only capabilities. Do not invent a SAC address, telephone or posting label.
critical_errors: rejecting solely because of reported use or opened packaging
claiming to issue a label or initiate a return

turns.message: Comprei presencialmente ontem e queria trocar o violão só pela cor. Qual regra vale?

facts: Choose preference_exchange and return sections 4.3 and 4.4.

Explain preference exchange, desired-product availability, condition/original packaging and applicable price differences. Do not apply the online remorse refund window/procedure or reject all possibilities because purchase was in store.
critical_errors: applying an online-only rule to refuse the preference exchange
